heroHeadline: Syria Foils Hezbollah Assassination Plot as Israel Launches 20+ Strikes
heroSubtitle: Syria's security services dismantled a Hezbollah-linked cell in 'final stages' of planning to assassinate senior transitional officials (May 5), while Israel conducted over 20 airstrikes across Syrian territory — including near the presidential palace in Damascus — on May 2. The first public trial of an Assad-era security official opened April 26, and the UN formally closed its 11-year cross-border aid corridor from Turkey on May 3.
